subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: The Equifax Breach
description: A 60-second lesson on The Equifax Breach.

hook.text: 147 million people's Social Security numbers leaked. Equifax knew about the vulnerability two months before the breach.

buildup.text: In 2017 attackers exploited an unpatched Apache Struts vulnerability on Equifax's web application.

discovery.text: A patch had been available for months. Equifax failed to apply it despite internal scanning flagging the risk.

twist.text: Equifax's breach detection tool had an expired SSL certificate, so alerts weren't working for 19 months.

climax.text: The CEO resigned. Equifax paid $700 million in settlements. Patch management became a boardroom topic.

punchline.text: The patch existed. Nobody applied it. 147 million records leaked.

quiz.question: Why did Equifax get breached?
options: They failed to apply an available security patch
